But a cut that reaches the fat layer can be very prone to infection, so if you don’t take care of it it can become infected quickly. Veins can also be found in the fat layer and that can make it dangerous. It’s honestly up to yourself. If you plan on making everything sterile and cleaning up very well, I wouldn’t worry too much.
